title: Noah's Ark
summary: Noah obeyed God by building the ark. God judged sin, saved Noah's family, and gave the rainbow as a sign of His promise.

read_it.prompt: Read how Noah listened to God, built the ark, and saw God's promise after the flood.

tell_it: People had filled the earth with wrong and hurtful things. God told Noah to build a big ark. Noah obeyed God, and God kept Noah, his family, and the animals safe through the flood.
understand_it: This passage teaches that sin matters, God is holy, and God keeps His promises. Noah did not save himself by being clever. He trusted and obeyed what God said.
age_5_7_explanation: Noah listened to God and built the ark. God kept Noah safe and gave a rainbow promise.
age_8_11_explanation: Noah obeyed God even before the flood came. The ark shows that God judges sin, saves His people, and keeps His promises.
teen_explanation: Noah's story holds judgment and mercy together. God takes evil seriously, yet He provides rescue and makes a covenant promise that He remembers.
key_truths: God is holy and sin has consequences.
God saves and keeps His promises.
Obedience means listening to God even when others do not understand.
life_application: If your friends laugh because you choose honesty, obedience can feel lonely. Noah reminds us that listening to God matters even when it is not popular.

quiz_questions.question: What did God tell Noah to build?
quiz_questions.explanation: God told Noah to build an ark so Noah's family and the animals would be safe.

quiz_questions.question: The rainbow reminded Noah that God keeps His ____.
quiz_questions.explanation: The rainbow was a sign of God's promise after the flood.

memory_verse.prompt: Remember the rainbow as a sign that God keeps His promise.

discussion_questions: Why might it have been hard for Noah to obey?
What does the rainbow help us remember?
What is one way you can obey God this week?

activity.title: Promise Rainbow
activity.instructions: Draw a rainbow. Under it, write one promise of God you want to remember when you feel worried.

prayer_prompt: God, thank You for keeping Your promises. Help me obey You even when it is hard.
